item.tib: bla chen yab sras gsum gyi thugs bsgrubs las zhi ba dngos 'grub rab 'phel
item.coloph: ces pa bla chen yab sras thugs sgrab zhi ba dngos grub rab 'phel zhes bya ba 'di ni gnas chen shel brag tu kho bo rang lo bdun thog sa phag zla tshes nyi shar 7 rig 'dzin 'chi med rnams kyis (kyi) tshogs gral du phyin nas dbang lung gsang mtshan man ngag phun tshogs bde chen dbang ldan gnang cing rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gnyer gtad lo bdun gsang rgya thub par byas nas phyis su bka' rgya yol nas dben gnas man Dal ri khrod du ge khod bsnyen bsgrubs skabs shing sbrul zla tshes kyi nub mor tshe dbang rig 'dzin chen po'i (pos) lo tsa'i brda' yig 'dug pa mngon sum kho bo dbra rigs g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag la gnang pa'i tshes kyi nyi shar la zhal bshus so//
